title: OracleResult
description: The result of one execution of the check of a finding. `reproduced`: the check ran and showed the expected effect. `refuted`: the check ran cleanly and the effect did not appear. `inconclusive`: the check ran and the result does not decide. `not_applicable`: the check did not run, for example because the application did not start or the command is not permitted; that is evidence about the environment, not about the finding. Only `reproduced` promotes a finding to the evidence class `reproduced`.

reason.description: Why the check did not run, or why the result does not decide.

command.description: The command as the runner received it. It can differ from the command of the check, because a test check is translated into the invocation of its repository.
